newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Prague metro line closed after smoke incident - CTK.
newsitem.headline: Prague metro line closed after smoke incident - CTK.

text.p: Several dozen people needed medical attention on Monday after smoke poured into a tunnel in a central section of Prague's underground railway, the Czech CTK agency reported.

It quoted a fire emergency official as saying that about 30 people had been treated on the spot or taken to hospital after smoke flowed into the tunnel around the Square of Peace (Namesti Miru) in central Prague.
Trains on the Metro's cross-town "A" line had been halted since about 10 a.m. (0800 GMT), CTK said.
Line "A" is the second oldest of the three lines on the system, which has been functioning since the late 1970s.
